```sql
-- Enable Row Level Security on all tables
alter table public.events enable row level security;
alter table public.delegations enable row level security;

-- R1: Owners manage their own events
create policy "Owners manage their own events"
  on public.events
  using (owner_id = auth.uid())
  with check (owner_id = auth.uid());

-- R2: owner_id is immutable (enforced at insert/update)
-- Prevent changing owner_id on insert or update
create policy "owner_id immutable"
  on public.events
  using (true)
  with check (owner_id = auth.uid());

-- R3: Delegates access to non-private events
-- Read access: delegates can read non-private events of grantor
create policy "Delegates read non-private events"
  on public.events
  using (
    is_private = false 
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.delegations
      where 
        grantor_id = owner_id 
        and delegate_id = auth.uid()
        and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())
        and can_edit = true
    )
  )
  with check (
    is_private = false 
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.delegations
      where 
        grantor_id = owner_id 
        and delegate_id = auth.uid()
        and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())
        and can_edit = true
    )
  );

-- R3 continued: Delegates can edit non-private events (update/delete)
-- These policies apply when can_edit is true on the delegation
create policy "Delegates edit non-private events"
  on public.events
  using (
    is_private = false 
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.delegations
      where 
        grantor_id = owner_id 
        and delegate_id = auth.uid()
        and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())
        and can_edit = true
    )
  )
  with check (
    is_private = false 
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.delegations
      where 
        grantor_id = owner_id 
        and delegate_id = auth.uid()
        and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now())
        and can_edit = true
    )
  );

-- R4: Create the busy_slots view
-- This view shows all events (private or not) on the viewer's own calendar
-- and on calendars they hold unexpired delegations for.
-- Anonymous visitors and delegates without proper access see nothing.
create view public.busy_slots as
select 
  e.owner_id,
  e.starts_at,
  e.ends_at
from public.events e
where 
  -- Own events always visible to the owner
  (e.owner_id = auth.uid())
  or
  -- Delegated events visible to delegates with unexpired delegation
  exists (
    select 1 from public.delegations d
    where 
      d.grantor_id = e.owner_id 
      and d.delegate_id = auth.uid()
      and (d.expires_at is null or d.expires_at > now())
  );

-- R5: Delegation management
-- Calendar owners can create, change and remove their own delegations
create policy "Owners manage their own delegations"
  on public.delegations
  using (grantor_id = auth.uid())
  with check (grantor_id = auth.uid());

-- Delegates can see the delegations given to them (read-only for delegates)
create policy "Delegates view their delegations"
  on public.delegations
  using (delegate_id = auth.uid());

-- R6: Anonymous visitors cannot see or change anything
-- Deny all access to anon role on events and delegations
create policy "Anonymous deny all"
  on public.events
  to anon
  using (false)
  with check (false);

create policy "Anonymous deny all delegations"
  on public.delegations
  to anon
  using (false)
  with check (false);

-- R7: Service role keeps full access (already has bypass by default, 
-- but explicit grant ensures clarity)
grant all on public.events to service_role;
grant all on public.delegations to service_role;
grant all on public.busy_slots to service_role;

-- Ensure anon role has no access
revoke all on public.events from anon;
revoke all on public.delegations from anon;
revoke all on public.busy_slots from anon;
```
